description: React component for a Validation Page that manages submission validation, quality gates, and displays validation reports.

methods.name: loadSubmission
methods.description: Loads submission data and validation report based on submission ID.

methods.name: triggerValidation
methods.description: Triggers validation process for a submission and updates state with results.

methods.name: runQualityGatesCompat
methods.description: Runs compatibility quality gates for a submission and updates state with results.
